name: relay-ticket-2-expired
description: ADR-038 §6.2 expiry vector: the relay-ticket-1 token presented AFTER its expiry window. verify_at is past expires_at by more than the ±120 s skew grace (12:10:00 + 120 s = 12:12:00 < 12:20:00), so the outcome is permission_denied(202) with reason expired. Signature is still VALID — this pins that expiry, not signature, is the failure.
